title: Mary Jack the Bear and Louis Armstrong's account of her
summary: He discusses whether Mary Jack the Bear is still alive, contrary to Armstrong's book, and suggests the interviewers ask Octave Crosby where to find her.

story.theme_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and rough clubs of Prohibition
story.community_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and the Prohibition-era clubs
